CustomObject.label: Sync Checkpoint
CustomObject.description: One row per mailbox/source. Holds the delta token, page cursor and run status for DeltaSyncJob. Chosen over Platform Cache deliberately: it survives an org restart and a cache eviction, and it is visible in the UI for support — durability was worth more than the extra read/write latency of a real object. Written on every page, not just at the end of a run, so a mid-run failure resumes rather than restarting.
